states.changed: The work exists: a building at night behind frosted glass, one room for each receiver the Field coded, and each of its 51 signals spoken in its own words by an open speech model in the room it is addressed to; in the street, where the visitor stands, the ten published texts are said clearly again and again, while at the deed and at 24, 24, 72 hours, five days and 15 days rooms the street cannot enter wake behind the glass, their words lines of light; the maker's log ticks until six months; any room can be stood in, and then the street is behind the wall. A machine listener still recovers 1,039 of 1,235 words through the wall.

Beside the paper, the building now runs as it happened, twice on record (the wiki and the escape of 2026), each from its deed to today: the deed beats behind the maker's wall while the agents act, the paper's hours pass with nothing public, and the deed is first told in the street, by strangers, after 116 days and after 7, while the street warms and the clock holds for each sentence of the record; a public body wakes days after the street, and in the escape someone walks from the street into the office with a report.
